fichas.title: Small goods lifts
fichas.summary: Small goods lifts, also called dumb waiters, transport light goods such as documents and food and are not intended for passengers. The page illustrates one-sided, pass-through, and corner-door arrangements, and gives cycle-time and transport-capacity formulas. Shafts are typically steel-framed and clad with non-flammable materials.
uses: Transport light goods, documents, and food

fichas.title: Goods lifts: types, structural dimensions, and stopping precision
fichas.summary: Goods lifts are intended to transport goods or employees of the lift operator. The page shows pass-through and one-sided loading arrangements, structural dimension tables for traction-sheave goods lifts, a cross-section, and stated stopping-precision and speed information.
